x: Siwana's ruler Shital Deva was defeated in Alauddin's Rajputana campaigns, so A is correct. Prataparudra II ruled Warangal (not Chittor, whose ruler was Ratan Singh), Ramachandra ruled Devagiri (not Dwarasamudra, which was Vira Ballala III's) and Hammir Deva ruled Ranthambore (not Madurai).
Malik Kafur was called Hazar Dinari because he had been bought for 1,000 dinars. He was acquired by Nusrat Khan during the 1299 Gujarat campaign and later rose to Malik Naib.
